reuse.why: The rule changes in the shared getScheduledAmount, but the API's expectedAmount re-implements range resolution inline instead of calling it, and only the preview path passes the operator needed for the approximate rule.

duplication.why: api-models.ts duplicates the missing/number/range dispatch of getScheduledAmount with the old furthest-from-zero rule, so it already disagrees with the helper's final lowest-value rule.

placement.why: The rule sits correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the API model computes its own version locally.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field, with some type churn to keep expectedAmount out of the create input.

maintainability.why: A now-meaningless rangeRounding parameter is kept and passed as 'roundedMidpoint' just to reach the new amountOp argument, the API field drifts from the helper, and posting/forecast/UI callers ignore the approximate rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts expectedAmount: getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch reshaped as a nested ternary with Math.abs comparison.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains a 4th positional amountOp parameter (behind the now-dead rangeRounding) and an 'isapprox' branch; api-models.ts bypasses it; only computeSchedulePreviewTransactions passes amountOp while schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and desktop-client callers do not.
